title: Deal With It: On Better Schedules for Listwise Reranking
abstract: arXiv:2611.22392v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faste

translated_title: Deal With It：论列表式重排序的更优调度方案
translated_abstract: 列表式 LLM 重排序器无法在单次调用中可靠地对数百篇文档进行排序，因此需要依靠调度方案来协调多次调用。并行调度将候选文档划分成若干组，并从每组中按固定配额向下一轮推进。当某个组包含的高质量段落超过其配额时，部分段落会被削减，从而需要进行代价高昂的修复调用。我们证明了候选文档的划分方式决定了配额在何处可能成为约束，并且就期望削减数量而言，最优的划分方式是像发牌一样按检索器排名以轮转方式分发候选。尽管这种“发牌”策略在概念上并不新颖，但此前一直缺乏理论分析。我们证明，在一个简单的检索器模型下，没有任何配额相同的划分方式在平均意义上比发牌削减更少的真实前十条结果，而连续分块的削减量会随检索器性能的提升而增加。DealRank 是我们分析所允许的最简单的调度方案，在两轮设置中对六个 LLM 的平均表现与最优调度方案相差不超过 0.1 个 nDCG@10 点，且速度始终快 1.1 至 1.4 倍。
tldr: 本文证明了在并行列表式重排序调度中，按检索器排名轮转“发牌”划分候选是均期望削减最少的最优分组方式，并提出简单高效的 DealRank 调度方案，在保持接近最优重排序质量的同时实现 1.1 至 1.4 倍的提速。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that dealing candidates round-robin by retriever rank is the optimal grouping strategy for parallel listwise reranking schedules, and proposes DealRank, a simple schedule that matches the best reranking quality while being consistently 1.1–1.4× faster.
